verdict.rationale: Release health is a fair question for an error-tracking product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows release bookkeeping: creating releases, recording deploys and associating commits via the CLI. Nothing documents crash-free session or user rates, per-release adoption, or comparing a canary release against a stable one, and the general Sentry API-compatibility claim does not establish this specific capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one
